messages:
maria: Heads-up — seeing a regression in rerank/embedding endpoint 95p latency after last runtime patch (kernel selector change). Dashboard spike at ~10:30 UTC.

maria: Quick stats from a few runs: QPS 420->430 (ok) but 95p token latency up 1.6x, tail99 also worse. Rerank batch sizes trending to 8->12 after selector change.

david: Can you paste the trace and kernel selection logs? Curious which kernels are being picked for dim=1536 vs 2048.

maria: perf-bot: profile run 177900-1 attached

perf-bot: ```
profile_id: 177900-1
model: reranker-v2 (1536d)
qps: 428
median_token_ms: 2.1
p95_token_ms: 8.9 -> 14.5
kernel_choices: matmul_fp16 (fallback) x 72%, matmul_int8 x 20%, custom_tvm x 8%
kv_hit_rate: 0.62 (down from 0.9 baseline)
batch_stats: avg_batch=9, tail_batch=16
```

sumeet: Looks like kernel selector is preferring matmul_fp16 fallback for these sequence lengths. When dims=1536 and seq<128, matmul_v1 is faster. We tuned selector to prefer the new vectorized matmul for larger dims but the heuristics missed mid-range.

anya: Also noticing KV cache hit-rate drop — our prefix eviction policy in the new batching path evicts frequently when batches compress. That increases compute (more full seqs) and pushes kernels to higher-launch overheads.

david: Re: dashboards — we should add token-level breakdown per route: kernel_choice tag, kv_hit, batch_size histogram, and per-route p50/p95/p99. Example Grafana query for p95 token by kernel tag:

```sql
SELECT percentile(token_lat_ms,95) FROM tokens
WHERE route='rerank' AND kernel_choice =~ /matmul_.*/
GROUP BY kernel_choice, time(1m)
```

maria: Good call. I'll add panels and a short-run canary to test selector revert. If we revert selector, expect p95 to drop back ~30% based on local runs.

sumeet: Quick mitigation: change selector rule: if dim<=1536 AND avg_seq<=160 prefer matmul_v1; also enforce kv-hotpath pinning to avoid eviction during batching spikes.

anya: Can we also emit kernel_choice as a top-level tag in traces? That would make sandboxing easier.

maria: Will add trace tag + new grafana panels. Rolling a canary in eng-stage in 15m. Assigning @david to validate dashboards, @sumeet to prepare selector branch, @anya to change KV eviction flag.

david: Ack. Will clean up dashboards and add a token breakdown panel. :thumbsup: \n
sumeet: pushing selector branch now, will open PR with perf numbers.

maria: Thanks — ping if you see any regressions during the canary. :eyes:
